comparison.objective: Rotate both faucet handles to fully open.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous bimanual grasping and 120-degree in-hand rotation of square knobs; no tool alignment, impact, fracture, or recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each handle scores when within 15 degrees of open and still seated. Release, damage, stability-duration, and force thresholds are not specified.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated rotary control of two retained knobs, meaningfully different from impact-driven tang removal and containment.
